title: layouts/<name>/schema.json
description: A layout descriptor: its named regions, documented grid variables, styling hooks and kind (spec §7). Not a props schema.

hooks.description: Styling hooks: a declared region's name -> a region hook (core/constants.js REGION_HOOKS: subtitle, meta, statement; title, kicker and accent are core's own). Core adds the class sd-<hook> to that region and to its element wrappers; themes style the hook, the layout CSS never does.

kind.description: content (default) or cover (core/constants.js LAYOUT_KINDS). Core sets it as data-kind on the canvas; a cover's title takes the cover size, and the cover-figure size when a region named `figure` holds an element.
